read.thesis: Container line in a freight-rate upcycle: Q3 average rate $2,480/TEU (+55% YoY) and adj. EBIT margin 37%, with FY26 adj. EBITDA guidance raised to $3.3-3.5bn; supply is still expanding via 56 newbuilds (~60% of fleet).

triggers.label: Avg freight rate +55% YoY to $2,480/TEU
triggers.quote: Our average freight rate per TEU in the third quarter was $2,480 per TEU compared to $1,602 per TEU in the third quarter of last year, reflecting a 55% increase.
triggers.highlight: $2,480 per TEU compared to $1,602 per TEU

triggers.label: FY26 adj. EBITDA raised to $3.3-3.5bn
triggers.quote: So we have a guidance for the end of year 2026 of EBITDA of USD 3.3 billion to USD 3.5 billion for adjusted EBITDA

triggers.label: 56 newbuilds, 418k TEU, ~60% of fleet
triggers.quote: The total capacity of these vessels is 418,000 TEUs that represent approximately 60% of our capacity today.
triggers.highlight: 418,000 TEUs that represent approximately 60% of our capacity today

triggers.label: Softening in recent weeks
triggers.quote: We do see some softening in recent weeks.
triggers.highlight: We do see some softening in recent weeks

guidance.quote: So we have a guidance for the end of year 2026 of EBITDA of USD 3.3 billion to USD 3.5 billion for adjusted EBITDA
adjusted EBIT of $2 billion to $2.2 billion
one can calculate the net leverage ratio further reduction to a very low number by the end of the year
